# Data Source: identitynow_custom_password_instruction

Use this data source to read the custom password instructions of a page.

~> **Note:** This data source uses an experimental API that may change without notice.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_custom_password_instruction" "reset_password" {
  page_id = "reset-password:enter-password"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `page_id` (String) Page the instructions are shown on, e.g. `reset-password:enter-password`.

### Optional

- `locale` (String) BCP 47 language tag of the instructions. Defaults to `default`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier in the form `<page_id>/<locale>`.
- `page_content` (String) Instructions in basic HTML.
